review.diagram_merit: yes, as an optional geometric index-reversal schematic
review.finding: A disk with ordered punctures and labeled adjacent arcs can show the half-turn carrying arc i to arc n-i. This clarifies the geometric reason for generator-index reversal. The displayed positive-monoid identities and their proof remain algebraic; missing art is not a defect.
review.geometry_and_endpoints: The half-turn reverses the order of punctures, taking puncture k to n+1-k and adjacent arc i=(i,i+1) to arc n-i=(n-i,n+1-i). It is orientation-preserving, so the positive half twist on arc i maps to the positive half twist on arc n-i; it does not change the crossing sign. The half twist Δ has endpoint permutation i↦n+1-i.
review.identity_and_map_direction: In B_n^+, σ_i Δ ≡+ Δ σ_(n-i) and Δ σ_i ≡+ σ_(n-i) Δ. These are two-sided sliding identities in the positive monoid. After embedding in B_n, the second gives Δ σ_i Δ^(-1)=σ_(n-i); equivalently the first gives Δ^(-1) σ_i Δ=σ_(n-i). No Δ inverse is used in the monoid equalities or their proof.
review.word_order_and_crossings: Use the source convention Δ=T_1⋯T_(n-1), T_k=σ_k⋯σ_1, with Δ_n=Δ_(n-1)T_(n-1). Keep products in the written order; for a geometric stacking diagram make clear that the library reads the rightmost factor first. Label σ_i as the positive crossing of adjacent strands i and i+1, and preserve its positive sign under the disk half-turn. Do not substitute the reversed word as a literal word equality; the source proves its braid class equals Δ.
review.related_maps: τ is the monoid automorphism σ_j↦σ_(n-j), which permutes generator indices without reversing word order; ρ is the anti-automorphism fixing each generator and reversing product order. The source keeps these distinct. No left/right divisibility claim is used in this lemma.
review.related_block_slide: The secondary identity σ_j T_k ≡+ T_k σ_(j+1) is stated for 1≤j≤k-1. The upper bound matters: for k≤n-2, the excluded case j=k has different generator supports on its two sides; for k=n-1, σ_(k+1) is not a generator.
review.screenshot_review: All three listed local PNGs were viewed at original resolution. Together they show the statement and assumptions, the sliding/reversal/conjugation proof steps, and the concluding remarks. The receipt reports tikz_count=0 and diagram_failures=[].
